issues.quote: At nine Monnier had made us all show our watches, as he does every year. I kept mine in my pocket.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no time for the watch-showing. It says only that at dinner he would not show the master his watch. Nothing places any event at nine.
issues.misreading: A solver could take 'at nine' as a clock reading tied to the watch-showing, and possibly as a fixed time that bounds when dinner ended or when he was in the dining room. Because the transcript puts this after 'I sat on alone', it could also be read as contradicting 'At dinner' in the sheet.
